en.t: The inside of the submarine was dim.

units.source_text: 四周都是机器，他弓着腰，透过小小的方镜眺望。

en.t: Machines surrounded him on every side, and he bent at the waist to gaze out through a small square mirror.

units.source_text: 映在方镜里的是明亮的军港风景。

en.t: Reflected in the square mirror was the bright scene of a naval port.
